name: Daniel Lamoureux

events.title: Baptism of son Andre
events.description: 'andre la Moureux ... fils de Daniel la Moureux et de Jeane son Epouze'; godparents Isaac Quantin and Ester Masse; the father signs 'Daniel Lamoureux'

events.title: Baptism of son Daniel
events.description: Baptized by Moulinars; parents 'daniel et Jeane la moureux'; godparents Daniel la Moureux and Susanne la Moureux; father signs

bioAdditions: The printed registers of the French Church of New York contain two baptisms of Daniel's children, and he signed both entries himself (S1). Andre was born 10 Jan and baptized 17 Jan 1722, and his godmother was Ester Masse. A Masse godparent supports the family record's statement that Daniel's wife Jeanne was a Masse; Pierre Masse's daughter Jeanne was baptized at the same church in 1696. Daniel, born 18 May, was baptized on 29 May 1720, with godparents Daniel la Moureux and Susanne la Moureux. The register has no marriage for Daniel and Jeanne, and no baptism for their son Jean (b. 31 Dec 1723) or for the later children, who the Davenport genealogy says were born at New Rochelle and Philipstown. The 28 Jun 1719 marriage date in that genealogy (and on FamilySearch) is therefore not from this register (S1, S2).
openQuestionsNew: The marriage of 28 Jun 1719 is not in the French Church register. Try the NYC Dutch Church marriages, the NY marriage licences (Names of Persons for whom Marriage Licenses were Issued, 1860) and the New Rochelle French Church records.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Supported by the Bristol baptism and the NY French Church baptisms of his sons.
